entries.reason: measured ios 13.0, not the 8.0 baseline; gift.scn's and star2.scn's real 'frontal' light is an area light, confirmed by loading the real asset with macOS SceneKit -- so this constant is load-bearing for the very first tier, not a later-tier nicety
entries.effect: SCNLight.type accepts this string; the area light's own geometry (areaExtentsX/Y/Z, areaPolygonVertices, drawsArea) is not decoded yet, so it currently falls back to a point-light approximation
SCNMaterial.lightingModelName compares and stores this exact string; none of the four target assets use it
